source.collection: Hemeroteca Digital BN, Correio da Manhã, coleção 089842

method.control_plane: Jatobá SSH only, max_memory_mb=128 explicit; all PDF rendering performed on Ifro
method.visual_exam: Original SHA-256 and pdfinfo reconfirmed. Full-page panorama for each page; 3600-pixel-high render, read in four 2x2 overlapping quadrants per page. Text judged from facsimile, no OCR.

readings.subjects: International affairs: Soviet condition over Cuba, Britain, Cuba executions, Catholic council. The brief SATÉLITE (Moscou, UPI-CM) says the USSR announced a new uncrewed artificial Earth satellite on the previous day; no satellite ID, descent, impact, Bahia, or Conde event is supplied.
unrelated_clock_labels: 10h50m GMT = airport departure time for US military Big Lift (Frankfurt), not an observation above Conde
readings.disambiguation: The SATÉLITE brief describes a Soviet launch announced around 12 Nov 1963; it cannot be equated with either an 8 Nov 1963 decay or the Conde report. NASA/NORAD identities absent.

readings.subjects: Brasília/Senate, real-estate rent strike, coffee meeting, air workers pay, Boeing 727 orders, and article EM LAGOA CAPIXABA FOGO HÁ DEZ DIAS concerning a burning lagoon in São Mateus, Espírito Santo, near Linhares and BR-5.
unrelated_clock_labels: há dez dias = reported duration of a lagoon surface fire in Espírito Santo, not the local hour of a sky incident in Bahia
readings.disambiguation: Lagoon-fire report explicitly considers a 'meteorito' only as an unverified hypothesis among methane/natural gas or oil explanations; it concerns São Mateus/ES, not Conde/BA, and supplies neither a witnessed satellite descent nor a Conde event hour.

readings.subjects: Editorial Uma política autêntica about commerce and development; Mundo Político, political reforms, editorial Explicação on strike law, and cultural essays Ponto de Português and O Eterno Presente.
readings.disambiguation: The word Lua in the cultural essay is a literary comparison, not a scientific observation or news of a space object.

readings.subjects: Indicador de hoje with weather, local train schedules, tide table, public-service notices; social assistance Oitenta senhoras ajudam favelados; strikes in Sandovalina; São Paulo public salaries; Mafia extradition and commercial automobile advertisement.
unrelated_clock_labels: 1h55m, 8h40m, 14h25m, 21h00m = predicted Rio tidal times, not hours of Conde episode
8h–18h = social-assistance clinic opening hours in a separate Rio story
readings.disambiguation: Weather and tide schedule dates/times are municipal forecast and logistics, not a named witness or astronomical object in Conde.

scope.article_level_independence: No article on Conde identified in this four-page scope; unrelated articles are not event witnesses.
